Chapter 7023: Decision

Chapter 7023: Decision

“Your background doesn’t change your fate today.” Li Qiye remained unmoved.

“We’ll see about that!” Autumn Wind roared furiously.

“Poof!” The tree exploded, releasing all withering specks capable of rotting immortal bodies. It intended to kill everyone here in Dusk.

“This is bad!” All immortals fled immediately.

Li Qiye naturally didn’t permit this and closed his palm, preventing the eruption and crushing the branches.

“Ahh!” Autumn Wind bellowed as its head and tree spine were being ripped out along with its true fate.

The agony surpassed imagination, sending chills into listeners. This was the first time they saw a golden immortal being so fragile.

Li Qiye waved and burned the tree to a crisp. Next, he incinerated the tree’s true fate while it still screamed in horror.

Only a tiny piece of the spine was left behind, surrounded by the refined essences.

“Pop!” He tossed it into the ground like a seedling. It drilled deeper underground and would eventually become a divine tree.

Although this appeared to be a good outcome, spectators were horrified. After all, Autumn Wind’s true fate was destroyed already.

“Make your move.” Li Qiye told the two horrified machine fortresses.

After seeing their hesitation, he smiled: “There’s no other chance.”

“Go!” The brothers roared and gathered powers, conjuring a golden and silvery radiance in preparation for an ultimate explosion.

“They’re suiciding!” The crowd was horrified.

Both brothers had no intention of surviving after seeing Li Qiye’s power. Thus, they wanted to at least draw blood or injure him. This would be a better fate than Autumn Wind’s.

“Not that easy to die.” Li Qiye placed his palms together and suppressed the explosion.

The brothers’ radiance dimmed immediately. He had somehow reversed the explosion process and changed them back to the combined fortress form.
